title: I Spent 30 Minutes With Apple’s CEO. Now I Know Why John Ternus Got the Job
gist: Wired's Steven Levy says new Apple CEO John Ternus, 51 and CEO for under two months, launched a touchscreen MacBook Pro with little fanfare, signalling a product-first Apple in the age of AI.

insights.claim: John Ternus, a 25-year Apple veteran aged 51, has been Apple CEO for less than two months and used a low-key MacBook Pro launch that introduced the first touchscreen Mac.
insights.speaker: Steven Levy
insights.so_what: Leadership transition is complete and the first Ternus-era product is a significant Mac hardware change.
insights.locator: Ternus, who at 51 is on the younger side

insights.claim: The author reads Ternus's tenure as hardware-first, with Apple signaling that hardware still matters in the age of AI.
insights.speaker: Steven Levy
insights.so_what: Suggests Apple will differentiate on devices rather than racing frontier AI models.
insights.quote: in the age of AI, Apple is beaming out the message that hardware still rules
